name: RPCS3
about: RPCS3 on Windows, Linux and the Steam Deck. Saves are folders in its dev_hdd0 starting with the game's ID (BLUS30443…), for its first user. On Windows RPCS3 lives where it was unpacked: set its folder in Settings › Saves if it's not one of the usual places. Its states are left out, as they load only in the build that made them.
